items.author: M. Okafor
items.title: Regional grid operators pilot shared load-forecasting model
items.summary: Four operators began a three-month trial of a shared forecasting model this week. Early figures suggest a modest reduction in day-ahead reserve requirements, though the operators cautioned that the sample is small and seasonal.

items.author: L. Fenwick
items.title: Open-source container runtime ships incremental snapshot support
items.summary: The 2.9 release adds incremental snapshots and a rewritten garbage collector. Maintainers report faster cold starts for large images and a smaller on-disk footprint for layered builds.

items.author: R. Delacroix
items.title: Standards body publishes draft for portable build attestations
items.summary: A working group released a first public draft covering portable build attestations. The draft focuses on a signing envelope that survives re-hosting across registries; a comment period runs through the end of next month.

items.author: P. Nakamura
items.title: University lab releases dataset on urban heat retention
items.summary: The dataset covers eleven cities across three years and pairs surface temperature with material and canopy metadata. The lab is inviting external groups to reproduce its baseline before the figures are finalized.
